== Course of events ==

After the Gump carried Tip, The Scarecrow, Nick Chopper, Jack Pumpkinhead, Woggle-Bug, and Saw-Horse south through the night and into dawn, the great wooden creature bore the group beyond the Land of Oz into unfamiliar territory. Somewhere in this unknown country the travelers came upon a hidden nest, and the whole party tumbled into it, falling unharmed among a hoard of stolen treasures gathered there.

Amid the glittering hoard, the Woggle-Bug came upon a diamond necklace, which he presented to Nick Chopper, the Tin Woodman, as a gift plucked from the nest's stolen riches.

The travelers' presence in the nest did not go unchallenged for long: the Jackdaws to whom the hoard belonged returned and attacked the group, forcing Nick Chopper to fight them off with his axe while Saw-Horse kicked out with its wooden legs to help drive the birds away.
